description: This file defines a Python module for integrating OpenTelemetry-based tracing attributes specifically for Arize in a language model context. It provides classes and functions to set trace span attributes related to messages, responses, tools, and configuration parameters, used for observability and debugging of LLM interactions.

classes.name: ArizeOTELAttributes
classes.description: A class subclassing BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes that provides static methods to set OpenTelemetry span attributes related to messages and responses in LLM tracing.

methods.name: set_messages(span: "Span", kwargs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sets tracing attributes for message inputs in the span, including content and role, supporting chat message conventions.

methods.name: set_response_output_messages(span: "Span", response_obj)
methods.description: Sets tracing attributes for message outputs from LLM responses, including content and role.

methods.name: _set_tool_attributes(span: "Span", optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Helper to set tool and function call attributes on the span based on optional parameters.

methods.name: _set_response_attributes(span: "Span", response_obj)
methods.description: Helper to set response output message and usage token count attributes on the span.

methods.name: set_attributes( span: "Span", kwargs, response_obj, attributes: Type[BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes] )
methods.description: Main function to populate span with various OpenTelemetry attributes for tracing model requests, responses, and metadata in a standardized way.
